title: Anthropic’s landmark $1.5B copyright settlement is approved
abstract: Anthropic can finally start cutting checks to a group of authors and book publishers that sued the AI lab over copyright infringement. A federal judge gave final approval Monday of Anthropic’s landmark $1.5 billion settlement of a class action copyright lawsuit, Reuters reported . Judge William Alsup of the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California issued a preliminary approval of the settlement last year, after ruling that Anthropic had illegally downloaded and stored millions of copyrighted books. Alsup has since retired and Judge Araceli Martinez-Olguin signed off on the settlement on Monday. The payout will deliver $3,000 per work across an estimated 500,000 works, shared among the authors and publishers who hold rights to them. While the settlement is believed to be the largest in the history of U.S. copyright law, many authors and creators still don’t view it as a win. That’s because of how the legal question was resolved. Alsup sided with Anthropic on the core issue. He ruled that training an AI model on copyrighted text counts as fair use — a decision widely seen as a turning point for the AI industry. But the ruling didn’t excuse how Anthropic obtained the books in the first place. Anthropic had built its training library from two sources: books it purchased and scanned (fine), and books it downloaded from pirate sites like Library Genesis and Pirate Library Mirror. Alsup found the second method illegal on its own terms and said that piracy question could go to trial; Anthropic agreed to a settlement soon after to avoid a trial and whatever damages a jury might have awarded. While the final approval closes out this case, it doesn’t settle the legal question industrywide because Alsup’s ruling was a single district court decision, and Anthropic’s decision to settle means the case will never reach an appeals court to become binding precedent. abstract: research area Methods and Algorithms content type paper published July 2026 Environment-free Synthetic Data Generation for API-Calling Agents Authors Seanie Lee, Sanjoy Chowdhury, Chao Jiang, Cheng-Yu Hsieh, Ting-Yao Hu, Alexander T Toshev, Oncel Tuzel, Raviteja Vemulapalli View publication Copy Bibtex Training API-calling large language model (LLM) agents demands massive amounts of high-quality trajectories. However, collecting such data at scale typically requires fully implemented environments with executable APIs and realistic, pre-populated backend databases, creating a major bottleneck for scalability. To overcome this, we propose an environment-free synthetic data generation approach that leverages LLMs as on-the-fly digital world models. Given only API specifications, our method generates trajectories mimicking interactions between an agent and a stateful environment. Specifically, an LLM first generates diverse tasks solvable with the provided APIs. A teacher agent then iteratively solves each task while an LLM simulator generates coherent synthetic API responses conditioned on the task context and simulation history. Finally, an LLM judge filters the trajectories to ensure the quality of the resulting dataset. We evaluate our approach on the challenging AppWorld and OfficeBench benchmarks, which include both information-retrieval and state-changing tasks. Fine-tuning models on our synthetic data yields significant performance gains, demonstrating that effective supervision for API-calling agents can be generated without any executable environment. Our results establish LLM-based API simulation as a practical, scalable solution for training agents across diverse API ecosystems. Related readings and updates. abstract: research area Computer Vision conference ECCV content type paper published July 2026 Accelerating Text-to-Video Generation with Calibrated Sparse Attention Authors Shai Yehezkel†**, Shahar Yadin, Noam Elata, Yaron Ostrovsky-Berman, Bahjat Kawar View publication Copy Bibtex Recent diffusion models enable high-quality video generation, but suffer from slow runtimes. The large transformer-based backbones used in these models are bottlenecked by spatiotemporal attention. In this paper, we identify that a significant fraction of token-to-token connections consistently yield negligible scores across various inputs, and their patterns often repeat across queries. Thus, the attention computation in these cases can be skipped with little to no effect on the result. This observation continues to hold for connections among local token blocks. Motivated by this, we introduce CalibAtt, a training-free method that accelerates video generation via calibrated sparse attention. CalibAtt performs an offline calibration pass that identifies block-level sparsity and repetition patterns that are stable across inputs, and compiles these patterns into optimized attention operations for each layer, head, and diffusion timestep. At inference time, we compute the selected input-dependent connections densely, and skip the unselected ones in a hardware-efficient manner. title: Exploring self-distilled reasoning for supervised fine-tuning with Amazon Nova
abstract: When you fine-tune a model using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), creating high-quality chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning traces for your training data is often impractical and can be prohibitively expensive. As a result, you might choose to skip reasoning during SFT and train with only inputs and outputs. However, reasoning is a key capability of the Amazon Nova 2 family of models, and it’s been shown to significantly enhance prediction performance in Nova and other frontier models, often with performance gains on hard problems like coding and math. With Amazon Nova 2 customization, you can use the power of thinking models on your specific domains through techniques such as SFT and Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT). For SFT, a key requirement to unlock these gains is the availability of golden CoT traces in the SFT dataset, that is, thinking traces from a strong teacher model that have been further validated and cleaned. In this post, we explore an idea for generating thinking tokens for datasets that lack reasoning traces in SFT customization. We first examine the reasoning suppression problem, then introduce Self-Distilled Reasoning (SDR), validate it across three benchmarks, and provide practical recommendations. SDR re-uses the chain of thought from the base Amazon Nova 2 Lite model as a stand-in for non-reasoning datasets. Through our experiments we make a few observations on the impact of introducing SDR, from improving target performance to mitigating catastrophic forgetting . This is in line with a growing body of work that is discovering the importance of distilling information from a model into itself during training, otherwise known as self-distillation . abstract: WAIC重磅成果｜上海儀電智算牽頭成立“智算系統架構聯盟”並發布《超節點系統架構規範》 量子位的朋友們 2026-07-21 17:39:34 來源： 量子位 在上海市經濟和資訊化委員會指導下，由上海儀電智算牽頭，聯合GPU晶片、互連、整機、大模型、軟體等20餘家產業鏈上下游主體共同發起的“智算系統架構聯盟”（以下簡稱“聯盟”）在2026世界人工智慧大會上正式成立，同步釋出《超節點系統架構規範》（以下簡稱“規範”）。聯盟立足上海、輻射全國，旨在匯聚生態合力、共築開放架構，為智算基礎設施高質量建設保駕護航，並明確由儀電—中興聯合實驗室負責日常運營。 錨定智算底座建設，破解產業升級核心痛點 智慧算力已成為數字經濟發展的核心驅動力，但算力資源供需不平衡、軟硬體適配壁壘高等問題制約著產業整體升級。上海儀電作為上海市智慧算力公共服務平臺的核心企業，已建成數座智算中心，累計完成數十款國產AI核心元件的測試驗證，形成百餘份測試報告，並自主研發“儀電智算雲平臺”，實現異構算力的統一納管與智慧排程。聯盟以“聚全棧生態築智算系統架構，踐國企擔當創自主可控底座”為核心使命，面向智算中心、超算叢集、行業算力底座等場景，提供系統化、一體化的規劃與建設方案。 構建多元組織架構，打造全棧生態協作平臺 聯盟由儀電智算牽頭，聯合階躍星辰、稀宇科技、天數智芯、壁仞科技、平頭哥、寒武紀、東方算芯、沐曦股份、燧原科技、思朗科技、中興通訊、新華三、浪潮集團、算豐資訊、曙光資訊、曦智科技、馭馴網路、清程極智、趨境科技、基流科技、矽基流動、雲脈芯聯、雲合智網等23家智算產業鏈上下游企業共同發起（排名不分先後），從底層晶片到上層應用的完整產業鏈協作體系，聚合異構算力與技術資源，打破算力壁壘，推動軟硬體協同適配。聯盟成員可深度參與超節點建設規範等行業標準的研討與編制，優先使用聯盟真機測試驗證環境，高效完成產品適配與效能調優，縮短研發迭代週期；同時依託聯盟平臺聯動龍頭企業與國家級實驗室，開展前沿技術協同攻關，聯合申報重大科研專項與示範工程，打通產業鏈上下游合作渠道，推動供需精準匹配與業務協同。 釋出聯盟首項規範，確立智算行業技術統一基準 《超節點系統架構規範》（1.0版）作為聯盟首項成果，分為硬體與軟體兩部分。硬體方面，採用冷板式液冷整機櫃，統一節點尺寸並通過電、液、網三匯流排盲插實現前維護，配備集中供電、液冷散熱與漏液聯動隔離，通過高速互連背板實現Scale-up部署；軟體方面，規範了運維管理、叢集納管與拓撲感知排程、集合通訊、儲存與資料載入、安全可信及符合性驗收等要求。後續，上海儀電將據此規範打造自主超節點叢集。 聯盟成立與規範釋出，標誌著上海在構建自主可控智算產業生態上邁出堅實一步。未來，聯盟將持續拓展合作網路，以系統化規劃方案與全棧生態協同合力，成為智算基礎設施建設的重要加速器，為上海加快建設人工智慧高地貢獻力量。 本文由儀電智算提供，量子位獲授權轉載，觀點歸原作者所有。 版權所有，未經授權不得以任何形式轉載及使用，違者必究。 儀電智算 量子位的朋友們 WAIC重磅成果｜上海市教育算力專區正式開啟試執行 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜智愛賽思全面升級並發布科研專屬Token Plan 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜儀電智算雲在國家人工智慧應用中試基地建設中展現全棧服務能力 2026-07-21 國內首個！阿里健康氫離子達成NEJM、JAMA、BMJ三大醫學頂刊內容合作 2026-07-21 掃碼分享至朋友圈

title: WAIC重磅成果｜上海市教育算力專區正式開啟試執行
abstract: WAIC重磅成果｜上海市教育算力專區正式開啟試執行 量子位的朋友們 2026-07-21 17:30:03 來源： 量子位 在上海市教委、市經濟資訊化委的指導下，由上海儀電牽頭，上海電信、上海移動、上海聯通協同共建的 上海市教育算力專區 在2026世界人工智慧大會上正式開啟試執行。作為上海市教育領域專屬公共算力資源池，該專區的落地投用，將夯實上海人工智慧賦能教育發展的普惠算力底座，為全市教育創新發展注入智算動能。 錨定國家戰略部署，打造專屬普惠算力公共服務平臺 上海市教育算力專區積極響應國家《“人工智慧+教育”行動計劃》，是面向全市中小學、高校打造的統一化、普惠化、開放化、安全化教育專屬算力公共服務入口。針對當前教育行業算力資源分散、獲取門檻高、排程標準不統一、使用管理不規範等痛點難題，平臺創新採用政企協同、算網融合的建設運營模式，打破算力資源壁壘，打通教育算力應用堵點，全方位支撐全市人工智慧教學改革、師生科創實踐、高校學術科研創新等核心場景發展。 為築牢堅實可靠的算力支撐底座，專區深度整合上海儀電自有算力底座與三大運營商優質算力資源，依託上海市智慧算力資源統籌排程服務平臺，搭建獨立專屬的國產化算力硬體叢集、開發除錯環境與大容量儲存資源池，構建出算力充沛、排程穩定、安全可控的教育專屬算力服務體系，可實現日均Token輸出量超千億級，全方位滿足各級學校教學實訓與科研攻關的智算需求。 創新多項核心功能，構建全學段全場景教育算力服務體系 相較於傳統零散的教育算力服務模式，上海市教育算力專區具備多重差異化核心優勢。平臺打通市級排程平臺與教育算力的業務鏈路，實現跨系統統一身份認證、智慧算力排程與全流程線上服務，大幅提升教育算力使用效率。 在普惠服務層面，平臺創新推出適配教研場景的算力卡普惠模式與專屬Token機制，精準分層匹配資源，既能滿足普及型教學實訓、師生基礎科創需求，也可支撐高精尖科研攻關、前沿技術探索等高階用算場景，實現差異化、精細化算力資源適配。平臺即時處理效能卓越——每分鐘Token處理量不低於500萬、每分鐘請求數不低於2000次、首Token時延控制在800毫秒以內，呼叫成功率達99%以上，服務可用性99.9%，全面保障教育場景下的高效穩定用算體驗。 產品能力全面覆蓋中小學AI教學科創、全學段師生實訓實踐、高校前沿科研攻關三大教育核心場景，實現教育算力全學段、全場景適配賦能。平臺已預置DeepSeek、GLM、MiniMax等10餘個主流國產大模型，學校開箱即用，無需自行部署，大幅降低AI教學與科研的入門門檻。 同時，平臺配套完善的標準化使用者手冊、合規管理協議及規範化合作框架，搭建起適配教育行業特性的安全管理體系、規範運營體系和規模化落地體系，為平臺長效穩定、合規有序執行提供堅實保障。 樹立政企協同標杆，助力上海深化“人工智慧＋教育”改革 上海市教育算力專區正式投入試執行，標誌著上海建成教育專屬公共算力新基建，實現了教育算力從零散化、碎片化使用，向專屬化供給、普惠化開放、規範化運營的跨越式升級。 專區的落地應用，有效降低了全市各類學校AI教育落地成本與應用門檻，為青少年科創人才培育、高校科研創新提質增效。未來，專區平臺將持續迭代升級，不斷擴容優質算力資源、最佳化智慧排程能力、豐富AI+教育創新應用場景，持續夯實人工智慧賦能上海教育發展的算力底座，全力助推上海打造 “AI+教育”新範式 。 本文由上海市教育算力專區提供，量子位獲授權轉載，觀點歸原作者所有。 版權所有，未經授權不得以任何形式轉載及使用，違者必究。 上海市教育算力專區 量子位的朋友們 WAIC重磅成果｜上海儀電智算牽頭成立“智算系統架構聯盟”並發布《超節點系統架構規範》 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜智愛賽思全面升級並發布科研專屬Token Plan 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜儀電智算雲在國家人工智慧應用中試基地建設中展現全棧服務能力 2026-07-21 國內首個！阿里健康氫離子達成NEJM、JAMA、BMJ三大醫學頂刊內容合作 2026-07-21 掃碼分享至朋友圈

abstract: WAIC重磅成果｜儀電智算雲在國家人工智慧應用中試基地建設中展現全棧服務能力 量子位的朋友們 2026-07-21 17:15:50 來源： 量子位 7月19日，上海儀電在2026世界人工智慧大會（WAIC）上正式釋出“智算雲賦能·標杆應用場景成果”，系統展示了其自主研發的儀電智算雲YiCloud在金融、製造、醫療三大國家人工智慧應用中試基地的規模化落地成效，全方位呈現“算力+模型+場景”全棧服務能力。 金融領域|深度支撐金融大模型生態構建 助力普惠金融風控新標杆 在中國銀聯承建的金融領域國家人工智慧應用中試基地建設過程中，儀電智算雲YiCloud憑藉垂類模型訓推一體化能力，為中國銀聯聯合17家機構共建的百億級金融語料及50萬條微調資料提供穩定算力支撐。基於全國產化訓練的雙基座模型，已形成L1垂域矩陣，幻覺率降低30%，安全合規能力提升25%，在國內主流模型中位列第一，複雜任務成功率超85%。目前，該平臺已成功支撐智慧銀行卡、跨境支付、全域信貸風控及雲閃付AI版等應用落地。在金融風控實戰中，儀電智算雲平臺助力攔截可疑交易超2億元，其中“票根經濟”場景累計處理22萬張票根，拉動消費規模達2.5億元，並賦能8000家商戶“Nihao China”專案，註冊使用者達23萬人，切實推動AI技術普惠實體經濟。 製造領域|賦能工業智慧體落地 全棧智慧體重塑生產體系 在上海電氣承建的製造領域國家人工智慧應用中試基地中，儀電智算雲YiCloud以彈性算力與模型服務能力為支撐，高效保障了51個基於行業領域模型的智慧體部署，覆蓋研發、生產、運維全鏈條。其中： 研發端：藉助AI+研發設計，工藝設計週期由“月級”縮短至“周級”，顯著提升研發效率； 生產端：通過AI+生產製造，實現訂單準時交付率100%，同時支援風險預警與動態能源調控，助力精細化生產管理； 運維端：AI+運維保障60萬臺電梯合規運營，風電大腦有效降低裝置故障停機率20%，大幅提升運維效率與安全性。 醫療領域|支撐AI醫療共性平臺建設 51項應用進入中試推廣 在復旦大學附屬中山醫院承建的醫療領域國家人工智慧應用中試基地程序中，儀電智算雲YiCloud作為基座平臺，按照“1+3+5+n”架構，深度參與集算力支撐、模型服務、語料生產、應用開發與評測安全於一體的共性平臺建設，重點聚焦智慧診療、智慧器械、醫用機器人三大產業方向。目前，以心血管病“觀心”輔助診療智慧體為代表的51項應用已進入中試推廣階段，為醫療AI產業化落地奠定堅實基礎。 從金融風控毫秒級智慧推理、製造業全流程高效智造，到醫療場景精準智慧診療，儀電智算雲YiCloud持續夯實國產化算力底座，深耕行業垂類模型創新與場景落地，以“算力+模型+場景”一體化全棧服務，打通人工智慧技術落地應用“最後一公里”，持續釋放數字算力價值，為各行各業數智化轉型、城市人工智慧產業高質量發展注入強勁動能。 本文由儀電智算雲提供，量子位獲授權轉載，觀點歸原作者所有。 版權所有，未經授權不得以任何形式轉載及使用，違者必究。 儀電智算雲 量子位的朋友們 WAIC重磅成果｜上海儀電智算牽頭成立“智算系統架構聯盟”並發布《超節點系統架構規範》 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜上海市教育算力專區正式開啟試執行 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜智愛賽思全面升級並發布科研專屬Token Plan 2026-07-21 國內首個！阿里健康氫離子達成NEJM、JAMA、BMJ三大醫學頂刊內容合作 2026-07-21 掃碼分享至朋友圈

title: 國內首個！阿里健康氫離子達成NEJM、JAMA、BMJ三大醫學頂刊內容合作
abstract: 國內首個！阿里健康氫離子達成NEJM、JAMA、BMJ三大醫學頂刊內容合作 量子位的朋友們 2026-07-21 14:03:10 來源： 量子位 近日，阿里健康醫學AI平臺“氫離子”先後宣佈與NEJM集團（《新英格蘭醫學雜誌》出版方）、JAMA美國醫學會雜誌及JAMA Network達成內容合作，加上此前簽約的BMJ集團（英國醫學雜誌），氫離子現已成為國內首個擁有全球三大醫學頂刊全文內容授權的醫學AI平臺。 在5月產品釋出會上，氫離子將與BMJ的合作定義為“與國際頂級期刊合作的起點”。兩個月後，NEJM和JAMA接連落定。從起點到集齊全球醫學界最具影響力的三大頂刊，阿里健康在頂級醫學證據上的戰略佈局正在快速兌現。 長期以來，中國醫生獲取全球最前沿醫學證據的通道並不通暢。頂刊文獻獲取成本高、語言門檻高、檢索效率低，是大多數醫生在臨床和科研中的實際負擔。比如查一個免疫治療方案的亞組療效，PubMed只有摘要，全文要付費登入，跨多個期刊分別檢索，一套流程可能費時半天。 現在，三家出版集團的合作已幾乎覆蓋所有臨床學科的核心證據資源：BMJ集團旗下70本醫學期刊近十年刊發的學術內容及多媒體資源、NEJM集團自1990年以來的所有出版內容及多媒體資源、JAMA及JAMA Network的所有已發表內容與多媒體資源，均已接入氫離子平臺。 醫生可以直接在氫離子上閱讀頂刊文獻全文，也可以通過AI問答獲取基於這些文獻的循證解答，所有引用均可追溯至原文段落，並支援中英對照研讀。過去“人找文獻”的模式，正在演變成“AI+證據推理”。氫離子在國際頂級醫學期刊上的持續投入，正是在為中國醫生搭建循證AI基礎設施。 阿里健康董事會主席兼執行長沈滌凡在簽約中表示，“醫生是醫療體系的核心支柱，也是面臨多重職業壓力的群體”。氫離子的使命是幫助醫生解決一切醫學問題，持續與國際醫學期刊的合作，是將全球頂尖醫學證據與AI能力深度融合，通過自然對話互動，直觀、快速且精準地輔助解答臨床與科研難題，為中國醫生提供更值得信賴的決策支援。 本文由阿里健康提供，量子位獲授權轉載，觀點歸原作者所有。 版權所有，未經授權不得以任何形式轉載及使用，違者必究。 阿里健康 量子位的朋友們 WAIC重磅成果｜上海儀電智算牽頭成立“智算系統架構聯盟”並發布《超節點系統架構規範》 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜上海市教育算力專區正式開啟試執行 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜智愛賽思全面升級並發布科研專屬Token Plan 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜儀電智算雲在國家人工智慧應用中試基地建設中展現全棧服務能力 2026-07-21 掃碼分享至朋友圈

title: 阿里Qoder上線全新安全能力，為每位使用者配備一位專屬安全工程師
abstract: 阿里Qoder上線全新安全能力，為每位使用者配備一位專屬安全工程師 量子位的朋友們 2026-07-21 13:44:29 來源： 量子位 7月21日，阿里Qoder上線全新安全能力Qoder Security，和傳統掃描工具靠規則匹配已知模式不同，該安全能力可在Qoder生成程式碼時同步開展安全檢查，發現問題後自動修復，並在下一輪掃描中閉環，覆蓋「發現、修復、再次驗證」的全鏈路，相當於為每一位使用者配備一位專屬安全工程師，可滿足企業級場景對安全的需求。 根據資料統計顯示，全球超過40%的新程式碼由AI輔助生成，這些AI生成的程式碼出現漏洞的機率要高於人工程式碼，但企業的安全審查能力並未同步提升。因此安全不能依賴人的自律與模型的自覺，必須內建於Agent的執行框架。 Qoder將“靜態掃描”升級為“主動式安全”方案，該方案集成了自研安全大模型，可理解程式碼上下文與汙點傳播路徑，對檢出的問題自我驗證可達性，只報告真實可達的風險。發現問題後由程式設計智慧體直接完成修復，下一輪掃描閉環再次驗證。 第一層漏洞即時攔截 為平衡成本、延遲和漏洞檢出率問題，解決成本與延遲的問題，Qoder還設計了三層安全護航，避免每一行程式碼都交給最強的大模型全量複核。在純文本的字元流級別任務中，程式碼生成的同時就篩查已知高危模式，危險函式呼叫這類問題即時發現、自動修復，可實現零延遲、零額外算力開銷；在一輪任務完成後，系統會在合適的時機給出後續建議，例如通過掃描檢測程式碼安全隱患，SQL隱碼攻擊、遠端命令執行、敏感資訊洩露這類需要理解語義才能識別的風險，大多都會在這一層被發現。 提交程式碼前，系統則會觸發最後一道防線，主動詢問是否需要掃描。Qoder Security可跨檔案、跨函式追蹤完整資料流，從汙點源到危險匯聚點，挖出單檔案視角永遠看不到的隱藏關聯漏洞。 測試資料顯示，相比傳統方案，Qoder Security漏洞檢出率提升約60%，告警誤報率降低約80%，單個漏洞從發現到修復可達小時級。據介紹，Qoder團隊使用Qoder Security對一批生產級開源專案與AI基礎設施元件進行了測試，這些專案大多擁有活躍的社群和成熟的工程實踐，其中不乏被全球開發者廣泛使用的明星專案，最終Qoder Security自主發現了600多個安全問題。 目前，Qoder國際版與Qoder CN的Qoder Desktop、Qoder CLI均已支援該能力，使用者可一鍵開啟，無需安裝或配置任何額外外掛。 本文由阿里Qoder提供，量子位獲授權轉載，觀點歸原作者所有。 版權所有，未經授權不得以任何形式轉載及使用，違者必究。 阿里Qoder 量子位的朋友們 WAIC重磅成果｜上海儀電智算牽頭成立“智算系統架構聯盟”並發布《超節點系統架構規範》 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜上海市教育算力專區正式開啟試執行 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜智愛賽思全面升級並發布科研專屬Token Plan 2026-07-21 WAIC重磅成果｜儀電智算雲在國家人工智慧應用中試基地建設中展現全棧服務能力 2026-07-21 掃碼分享至朋友圈

title: Controlling Reasoning Effort in LLMs
abstract: It has been almost two years since OpenAI released o1, a model that popularized the idea of LLM-based reasoning models. DeepSeek-R1 followed about four months later, together with details of a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) recipe to train such reasoning models. Last week, OpenAI released the GPT-5.6 model family. It comes in three sizes, each with roughly five or six reasoning-effort settings. So yes, reasoning models are here to stay. They have become a standard part of modern model releases. In the past, I covered the methodology of reasoning models ( Understanding Reasoning LLMs ) as well as relevant research papers ( The State of Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning and The State of LLM Reasoning Model Inference ). And I even wrote a whole new 440-page book on how to develop reasoning models, Build A Reasoning Model (From Scratch) . These resources have focused on turning a conventional LLM into a reasoning model. Now, in this article, I want to focus on and explain how to develop a reasoning model that has multiple effort modes, similar to what’s shown in the figure at the beginning of this article. No worries, this article can be read as a standalone article. However, the aforementioned resources may be interesting and useful. When talking about pretty much any machine learning or AI technique or subfield, the one lesson is that we usually shouldn’t take technical terms “literally”. For example, an (artificial) neural network in machine learning and AI doesn’t literally work like a biological neural network like the human brain. Similarly, when talking about “reasoning models”, we shouldn’t expect that these models literally reason like us humans. title: 🔬 The Lab of the Future Should Feel Like a Data Center — Andy Beam & Rafa Gómez-Bombarelli, Lila Sciences
abstract: Imagine a dark warehouse. Racks and racks of devices with wires, tubes, and electronics sticking out. The next AI data center? No. This is Lila Sciences ‘ dream for the future of science . A dark warehouse full of AI-guided robotics and lab equipment, cranking out new experiments 24/7, building toward a scientific superintelligence. Their automated lab is almost hypnotizing to watch. They have floating plates zipping around on Wall-E-esque tracks, used vision-language models to control Windows 95 boxes, and created the world’s largest collection of voided warranties . In the process they’ve built a massive library of scientific reasoning tokens. Over 10 trillion of them, all experimentally validated. No warranties were voided in the making of this video To say Lila is ambitious is an understatement. Their goal is a scientific superintelligence wired directly into the wet lab. They are all in on the bitter lesson , and the thesis follows from it: a lab is an infinite token generator. Produce data at scale, and the synergies give you a general reasoner that can tackle any scientific problem. They are committing hard. Biology, chemistry, drug discovery, and materials science, all at the same time. Time will tell if it works, but it is an exciting hypothesis. In our latest episode we sat down with Lila’s very own Andy Beam (CTO) and Rafa Gómez-Bombarelli (CSO, physical sciences) and went on a journey through the possibilities of AI-run science, almost as wide-ranging as Lila’s goals. Did we mention they do both materials science and biology? In the same AI science factory? Same time, same lab, same AI. Finally a guest who can settle a long-running debate we’ve had amongst ourselves: is biology or materials science harder? The internet is spent, science is next. Why Lila thinks the scientific method is the last untapped internet-scale dataset, and why they treat RL as a data generation mechanism with nature as the verifier. The lab as a data center. abstract: Tempo The blockchain for payments at scale. Tempo is a blockchain designed specifically for stablecoin payments. Its architecture focuses on high throughput, low cost, and features that financial institutions, payment service providers, and fintech platforms expect from modern payment infrastructure. You can get started today by integrating with the Tempo testnet , building on Tempo , running a Tempo node , reading the Tempo protocol specs or by building with Tempo SDKs . title: pydantic/monty
abstract: Monty A minimal, secure Python interpreter written in Rust for use by AI. Experimental - This project is still in development, and not ready for prime time. A minimal, secure Python interpreter written in Rust for use by AI. Monty avoids the cost, latency, complexity and general faff of using a full container based sandbox for running LLM generated code. Instead, it lets you safely run Python code written by an LLM embedded in your agent, with startup times measured in single digit microseconds not hundreds of milliseconds. What Monty can do: Run a reasonable subset of Python code - enough for your agent to express what it wants to do Completely block access to the host environment: filesystem, env variables and network access are all implemented via external function calls the developer can control Call functions on the host - only functions you give it access to Run typechecking - monty supports full modern python type hints and comes with ty included in a single binary to run typechecking Be snapshotted to bytes at external function calls, meaning you can store the interpreter state in a file or database, and resume later Startup extremely fast (<1μs to go from code to execution result), and has runtime performance that is similar to CPython (generally between 5x faster and 5x slower) Be called from Rust, Python, or Javascript - because Monty has no dependencies on cpython, you can use it anywhere you can run Rust Control resource usage - Monty can track memory usage, allo

title: EGenAI-DBR: a design-based framework for responsible generative AI integration in higher education
abstract:
This study introduces the EGenAI-DBR framework to help educators integrate GenAI responsibly in higher education. It addresses the tension between AI's pedagogical potential and academic integrity by providing educators with a practical, ethics-centred roadmap through the Conceptual–Strategic Integration Matrix (CSIM).
 
 
 
 This study employs a Design-Based Research (DBR) methodology structured across five layers: conceptual, structural, operational, analytical and ethical. A two-phase mixed-methods design was used – a baseline survey (N = 128) via Prolific and a classroom pilot (n = 25) at a Middle Eastern institution using Google Suite and Moodle.
 
 
 
 Students entered with high GenAI familiarity (M = 4.32/5). An intention–behaviour gap was identified: 62.5% recognised uncited AI use as misconduct, yet only 58.6% consistently cited it. Clear institutional guidelines were positively associated with student confidence (M = 4.37) and stronger intentions for continued responsible GenAI use (r = 0.34, p < 0.001).
 
 
 
 EGenAI-DBR represents the first empirically tested synthesis of DBR, academic integrity and GenAI integration, operationalised through the CSIM. Unlike prohibition or detection-based approaches, it embeds ethical reasoning directly into course design, offering an institutionally accessible model applicable across diverse higher education contexts.

title: Generative artificial intelligence adoption and employees' perspectives on AI at work: toward unalienated working life or AI-augmented alienation?
abstract:
Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is making its way into our working lives. Previous research has explored topics such as AI-related fears among working people and AI technology adoption in companies, but people's perceptions of AI in the context of AI adoption are still not well understood. This article looks at the intersection of AI technology adoption and AI-related job concerns in one company.
 
 
 
 A rapid ethnographic case study of a Finnish energy company during its introduction of a generative AI tool was conducted. This article explores: (1) How is AI technology adoption managed? (2) How do employees perceive AI-related social risks concerning their working lives? And (3) how are perceived risks related to AI accommodated? We utilized Marx's framework on alienation to analyze employees' AI-related job concerns and future perceptions, and improvisational change management theory to analyze technology adoption strategy.
 
 
 
 AI-related concerns included both job security-related and job quality-related concerns. AI-related fears also manifest in rhetorics on the alienation-reducing potential of AI and digital automation. Employees' initiative is emphasized in technology adoption, which underlines the importance of their AI acceptance.
 
 
 
 The article illustrates how AI acceptance is constructed in work culture, and it also shows how a classic theory can be relevant for analyzing AI perceptions. It demonstrates why employees' AI acceptance is central in the context of employee-led practices in AI technology adoption.

title: Beyond the prompt: understanding ChatGPT outcomes through the lens of IT identity
abstract:
As the use of ChatGPT continues to expand, understanding its impact on users remains an emerging area of study. This research investigates how individuals form a sense of identity around ChatGPT, applying the information technology (IT) identity framework, with an added outcomes component, to assess the psychological relationship users develop with the tool.
 
 
 
 A survey of 312 active ChatGPT users was conducted to evaluate the framework’s applicability in this context and to explore the resulting behavioral and experiential outcomes. The model was tested using partial least squares structural equation modeling.
 
 
 
 The results provide partial support for the IT identity framework in the ChatGPT context. The analysis indicates that regular interaction with ChatGPT is associated with the development of a distinct IT identity. Moreover, the presence of sufficient resources and organizational or contextual support significantly moderates this relationship, shaping user behaviors in meaningful ways. These behaviors, in turn, were linked to improvements in both individual performance and perceived social well-being. The findings also suggest that some relationships established in traditional IT contexts may operate differently in generative AI environments.
 
 
 
 By extending the IT identity framework to include specific outcome measures, this study offers a nuanced understanding of how AI-based tools like ChatGPT influence user identity and behavior based on the IT identity framework. The findings further contribute to understanding how AI-related identities form and highlight opportunities for refining IT identity theory in the context of generative AI assistants.
